description.value: The temporal lobe contour was traced from the inferior fundus of the circular sulcus of the insula through the temporal lobe stalk to the CSF of the temporal horn, following the superior border of the hippocampus; the amygdala gray matter was excluded.

spans.text: To obtain the contour and the area of the temporal lobe, when the inferior fundus of the circular sulcus of the insula was reached, a straight line was extended through the brain matter of the temporal lobe stalk to the CSF of the temporal horn. The tracing then followed the superior border of the hippocampus to the CSF on its medial surface and then the loop continued back to its origin. This method excluded the amygdala gray matter, which lies superior to the hippocampus.

description.value: The frontal lobe contour followed cortical and ventricular CSF inferior to the sylvian fissure and was closed through the lateral ventricle, corpus callosum, and interhemispheric fissure.
